description: Bulk-load files from Azure storage or OneLake into an EXISTING Warehouse table using T-SQL COPY INTO. Completes the authoring loop: create the table (warehouse query 'CREATE TABLE ...'), copy-into, then validate with describe-table / COUNT(*). Append-only (never deletes or overwrites) — a mutation (dry-run guarded, blocked by --readonly), not destructive.

data.hint: Validate the load: fabio warehouse describe-table --workspace <WS> --id <WH> --table dbo.Orders, or run a COUNT(*) via fabio warehouse query.

notes: --source must be HTTPS to Azure storage (*.dfs.core.windows.net / *.blob.core.windows.net) or OneLake (onelake.dfs.fabric.microsoft.com); plaintext http, embedded userinfo (user:pass@host), and non-storage hosts are rejected. --file-type is CSV or PARQUET (case-insensitive). CSV-only flags --field-terminator, --row-terminator, --first-row (e.g. 2 to skip a header), --encoding (UTF8|UTF16) are rejected with PARQUET. --columns gives an explicit target column list. Source authentication is chosen with --auth-mode: 'entra-id' (default — the caller's Entra identity, works for OneLake and any storage the signed-in user can read), 'sas' (requires --sas-token), or 'workspace-identity' (the Fabric workspace managed identity — emits CREDENTIAL = (IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity'), no secret; grant the workspace identity access to the source first, e.g. Storage Blob Data Reader, and provision it with fabio workspace provision-identity). --auth-mode workspace-identity is the recommended secure default for automation/pipelines (GA: 'Secure data ingestion with COPY INTO and Workspace Identity'). --auth-mode workspace-identity / entra-id reject a --sas-token (ambiguous); --auth-mode sas requires one. --dry-run prints the generated COPY INTO SQL with the SAS secret REDACTED and does not execute; --readonly blocks execution but still allows the dry-run preview. The target table must already exist — copy-into does not create it. Runs over native TDS (SQL-audience token; see the SQL-scope gotcha). Live-verified: loaded a CSV from OneLake into a warehouse table via Entra passthrough (header skipped with --first-row 2).
query_examples: fabio warehouse copy-into --workspace <WS> --id <WH> --table dbo.Orders --source https://acct.dfs.core.windows.net/c/orders/*.parquet --file-type PARQUET --auth-mode workspace-identity
